cases.description: Frames 0 and 1 of one 4-part PSBT transfer and frames 2 and 3 of another. Total, file type and encoding agree and no index repeats, so no header check can tell. SP-TX-5 says frames from two transfers MUST NOT be assembled into one payload. BBQr carries no whole-payload checksum, so a receiver meets this only by validating what it assembled. The reference join accepts these frames.
sources: frames: bbqr.split_qrs from coinkite/BBQr at 8dc7ef07d0d520763cc0001a885ca8d29ac8719a (python/bbqr/split.py), input file from test_data/
verdict: SP-TX-5 first sentence
cases.notes: bbqr.join_qrs returns 1152 bytes of type P for these frames; they begin with the PSBT magic: True.
